title: Mia Nicastro named to Becky Hammon Mid-Major Player of Year Watch List
text:
Western Illinois University Leathernecks Women's Basketball | Western Illinois University Leathernecks
Western Illinois University Leathernecks Women's Basketball | Western Illinois University Leathernecks
Western Illinois University senior forward Mia Nicastro has been named to the 2026 Becky Hammon Mid-Major Player of the Year Midseason Watch List, according to an announcement by Her Hoop Stats.
The Becky Hammon Mid-Major Player of the Year Award honors the top women's basketball player from mid-major conferences. Nicastro is one of 15 players nationally selected for the midseason watch list, representing 13 different conferences.
Nicastro has played a key role for the Leathernecks during the 2025–26 season and is recognized as one of the most consistent scorers in college basketball. She currently ranks among NCAA leaders in scoring and total points, contributing on both offense and defense. The senior forward's ability to score inside, draw fouls, and make free throws has created challenges for opponents throughout the season.
Beyond her scoring, Nicastro has also provided leadership for Western Illinois' young roster during conference play. Her rebounding and defensive efforts have been important factors in the team's performance this year.
The Becky Hammon Award was established in 2020 and is named after Colorado State All-American, six-time WNBA All-Star, and current Las Vegas Aces head coach Becky Hammon. Semifinalists will be announced in February, finalists in early March, with the winner revealed around the NCAA Final Four.
Nicastro's inclusion on this list highlights her strong senior season and brings further attention to Western Illinois on a national level.
The Western Illinois University Leathernecks Women's Basketball team is based in Macomb, Illinois, where it plays home games on campus. The team competes in the Ohio Valley Conference as part of its intercollegiate athletics program at Western Illinois University. The "Leathernecks" nickname was chosen to honor the U.S. Marine Corps, with Rocky the Leatherneck serving as mascot. More information about the team can be found on their official website.
For updates on Leatherneck Women's Basketball, visit GoLeathernecks.com or follow them on X (formerly Twitter), Instagram, and Facebook.
